# laravel_cloud_command (Resource)

Runs a command on a Laravel Cloud environment.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "laravel_cloud_application" "example" {
  name                         = "my-app"
  repository                   = "my-org/my-app"
  region                       = "us-east-2"
  source_control_provider_type = "github"
}

resource "laravel_cloud_environment" "example" {
  application_id = laravel_cloud_application.example.id
  name           = "production"
  branch         = "main"

  php_version  = "8.4:1"
  node_version = "22"

  uses_push_to_deploy = true
}

# Creating this resource runs a real command against the environment.
resource "laravel_cloud_command" "example" {
  environment_id = laravel_cloud_environment.example.id
  command        = "php artisan migrate --force"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `command` (String) The command to execute.
- `environment_id` (String) Environment ID to run the command on.

### Read-Only

- `created_at` (String) Creation timestamp.
- `exit_code` (Number) Exit code (0 = success, 1 = failure).
- `failure_reason` (String) Reason for failure, if any.
- `finished_at` (String) Command finish timestamp.
- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
- `output` (String) Command output.
- `started_at` (String) Command start timestamp.
- `status` (String) Command status (pending, command.created, command.running, command.failure, command.success).

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import laravel_cloud_command.example "{command_id}"
```
